1.defect: leading/trailing apostrophes are kept: tokenize("'quoted' words") gives ["'quoted'", "words"] (an example in the issue)

2.defect: equal counts keep first-seen order instead of alphabetical: wordFreq("z y x") gives z, y, x (an example in the issue)

3.defect: no diacritic removal: slugify("Héllo, Wörld!") gives "h-llo-w-rld" (an example in the issue)

4.defect: an invalid wpm is not rejected: readingTime("hi", 0) returns Infinity instead of throwing RangeError (a rule and example in the issue)

5.defect: an unreadable file exits 1 instead of 2 (an exit-code rule in the issue)

6.defect: the hard cut keeps max characters then adds the suffix, so truncate("abcdefghij", 5) gives "abcde…" (6 chars; an example in the issue)
